edges.reason: transfer() delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom() delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom() updates the allowance through _approve.
approve() writes the allowance through _approve.
_transfer performs an external swap call before updating balances.
_transfer sends ETH out via sendETHToFee before state settlement.
_transfer finalizes accounting through _tokenTransfer.
swapTokensForEth invokes the router swap, an external call.
sendETHToFee performs an external ETH transfer to the tax wallet.
manualSwap is publicly callable and triggers the external swap path.
manualSend is publicly callable and triggers the external ETH transfer.
createUniswapPair calls the factory and pair approve externally.
addLiquidity calls the router addLiquidityETH externally.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the router.
block.timestamp is passed as the liquidity deadline to the router.
Constructor derives the tax wallet from _msgSender().
transfer() uses _msgSender() as the token source.
approve() uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom() uses _msgSender() for the allowance deduction.
decreaseTax writes the new tax rate constrained by a require comparison.
increaseBuyLimit writes the new max transaction amount.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
_tokenTransfer mutates the balance mapping of all parties.
_transfer reads _taxFee to determine the applied tax rate.
_tokenTransfer multiplies and divides by the tax rate (SafeMath arithmetic).
sendETHToFee transfers ETH to the _taxWallet address.
manualSend forwards contract ETH to the _taxWallet address.
swapTokensForEth calls the configured Uniswap router.
lockTheSwap modifier toggles the _inSwap flag around the swap.
createUniswapPair stores the created pair address.
addLiquidity enables tax swapping.

_transfer reads the contract balance from _balance.
_transfer reads fee-exemption flags from _isExcludedFromFee.
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount limit.
_transfer enforces the _maxWallet holding limit.
